newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-PAKISTAN'S WAQAR FIRES OUT SUSSEX FOR 54.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN'S WAQAR FIRES OUT SUSSEX FOR 54.

text.p: Pakistan fast bowler Waqar Younis returned his best first-class bowling figures of eight for 17 as Glamorgan fired out Sussex for just 54 in an English county championship match on Friday.
Sussex, replying to Glamorgan's modest first innings of 172, lasted just 98 minutes on the second day at Swansea.
Glamorgan captain Matthew Maynard declared his side's second innings at 183 for nine, setting Sussex 302 to win. Sussex were 10 without loss at the close.
Waqar's wicket-taking spree in 11.5 overs came barely a week after he bagged seven for 25 to dismiss Lancashire for 51.
It was the best performance by a Glamorgan bowler since Malcolm Nash took nine for 56 against Hampshire in 1975.
"I am now getting into my rhythm much better than I was at the start of the season and hopefully things will get better and better," Waqar said.
"It was both swinging and seaming, I had the wind behind me and running in to bowl was comfortable and easy."
Little or no play was possible on the second day of the other matches.
Lancashire, beaten in their last three championship matches, had reduced Worcestershire to 58 for four and Middlesex had moved to 150 for three in their first innings against Yorkshire.
